top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a single, sharply identifiable idea, the magic-wavelength optical lattice, which allows many neutral atoms to be interrogated free of Doppler, recoil and light-shift errors. Independent laboratories now agree at the 10^-18 level, so maturity is established by measurement, and the clocks are already producing physics (millimetre-scale redshift, limits on varying constants and ultralight dark matter). The two-name allocation to Katori and Ye is the cleanest available, provided the citation is anchored on the lattice clock and treats the comb and single-ion control as enabling background only. P002 is a genuine prediction-and-experiment discovery with settled phases, but it is a younger field and the three-name allocation is less clear; it ranks above no award.
